name: 4-hydroxytryptamine
summary: 4-Hydroxytryptamine (4-HT, 4-HTA), also known as N,N-didesmethylpsilocin, is a naturally occurring tryptamine alkaloid. It is closely related chemically to the neurotransmitter serotonin, the psychedelic psilocin, and is the active form of the tryptamine alkaloid norbaeocystin.

pharmacology.text: 4-HT is a potent agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor similarly to psilocin (EC50 = 38 nM and 21 nM, respectively). It also shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor (Ki = 40 nM), the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor (Ki = 95 nM), and the serotonin 5-HT1B receptor (Ki = 1,050 nM).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as the active form of norbaeocystin, a natural compound in some mushrooms. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，被當作norbaeocystin（某些蘑菇中的天然成分）的活性形式來研究，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，被当作norbaeocystin（某些蘑菇中的天然成分）的活性形式来研究，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is a close twin of serotonin. Both are hydroxytryptamines, but serotonin carries its hydroxy group at the 5 position of the ring, while 4-hydroxytryptamine carries it at the 4 position, just like psilocin.
fact.zh: 它和血清素幾乎是雙胞胎。兩者都是羥基色胺，但血清素的羥基在環的第5個位置，4-羥基色胺則在第4個位置，和脫磷酸裸蓋菇素一樣。
fact.zhHans: 它和血清素几乎是双胞胎。两者都是羟基色胺，但血清素的羟基在环的第5个位置，4-羟基色胺则在第4个位置，和脱磷酸裸盖菇素一样。
